Natural isotopologue ladders per polarity

MSdev_feature_natural_isotopologues.Rd

Per-polarity wrapper around xcms_feature_natural_isotopologues. Run after MSdev_feature_EIC_similarity.

Usage

MSdev_feature_natural_isotopologues(
  object,
  sim_threshold = 0.9,
  ppm = 5,
  max_atoms = c(S = 3, Cl = 3, Br = 3, K = 1),
  intensity_factor_chon = 6,
  intensity_factor_hetero = 1.5,
  min_rel = 0.001
)

Arguments

object

MSdev object.

sim_threshold

numeric(1). Pairs need similarity strictly above this.

ppm

numeric(1). Tolerance of the m/z gap, ppm of the mean m/z.

max_atoms

Named integer. Maximum S, Cl, Br, K atoms per ion.

intensity_factor_chon

numeric(1). Allowed factor over the ceiling for C/H/N/O-only compositions.

intensity_factor_hetero

numeric(1). Allowed factor over the ceiling when S/Cl/Br/K is involved.

min_rel

numeric(1). Minimum theoretical ceiling for a k to be tried.

Value

MSdev object; each polarity's MS1 xcms object carries the isotopologue_* columns and otherData(xcms)$Isotopologue_Global.
